items.prompt: Which check detects a mistyped ID card number?
items.why: A check digit catches a swapped or mistyped digit.

items.prompt: What decimal value is 1010 0001 in 8-bit two's complement?
items.why: 1010 0001 is 161 unsigned, which is 161 - 256 = -95 in two's complement.

items.prompt: Why would Amy scan photos as JPG instead of BMP?
items.why: JPG is a compressed format, so the same photos take less storage than BMP.

items.prompt: Minimum bits needed to represent 30 000 staff numbers?
items.why: 15 bits give 32 768 combinations, enough for 30 000 numbers.

items.prompt: What is (2 < 3) AND (3 < 4)?
items.why: Both comparisons are true, so the AND returns true.

items.prompt: Which character set covers Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English?
items.why: Unicode encodes Simplified and Traditional Chinese along with English.

items.prompt: What is a benefit of e-government?
options: Easy public access to government information
items.why: E-government lets the public access government information more easily in digital form.

items.prompt: Why would Mary send a document as PDF instead of DOC?
items.why: PDF preserves the page layout so the document looks the same on any device.

items.prompt: What should Ms Li use to create student result slips?
items.why: Database reports use stored student information and marks to produce result slips.

items.prompt: Which task benefits from spreadsheet 'what-if' scenarios?
items.why: What-if scenarios estimate outcomes like product cost for different manufacturers.

items.prompt: What should a teacher edit to make a slide more attractive?
items.why: Improving the font and the chart makes the presentation look more attractive.

items.prompt: Which process is an example of data collection?
options: Inserting a card into an ATM
Placing a photo on a scanner
items.why: Taking meter readings gathers data; the other processes are input or capture tasks.

items.prompt: Which storage device lets a computer boot up quickest?
items.why: SSDs boot much faster than hard disks, so Z with an SSD boots up quickest.

items.prompt: Which is NOT an advantage of an SSD over a hard drive?
items.why: Both SSDs and hard drives support random access.

items.prompt: Which is correct about a device driver?
options: Enables the OS to manage files
items.why: A driver lets the operating system control a specific hardware device like a scanner.

items.prompt: What does 'fetch' do in the fetch-decode-execute cycle?
options: Obtains the instruction from main memory
items.why: Fetch retrieves the next instruction from main memory.

items.prompt: Which storage medium supports only sequential access?
items.why: Magnetic tapes can only be read sequentially, unlike DVD or flash.

items.prompt: Which statement about computer components is NOT correct?
items.why: Data buses carry data; control signals travel on the control bus.

items.prompt: Which is NOT appropriate for enhancing information literacy?
options: Searching online for an install password
items.why: Finding an installation password online is not a legitimate literacy practice.

items.prompt: Which factor improves video conferencing quality?
items.why: Higher network bandwidth gives a smoother, higher quality video call.

items.prompt: Which protocol is involved when browsing https://www.gov.hk?
items.why: DNS resolves the domain name before the browser fetches the page.

items.prompt: Which identifies a host computer on the Internet?
items.why: An IP address uniquely identifies a host computer on the Internet.

items.prompt: What is the main function of a network interface card?
options: Find a route for data packets
Enhance the security of a link
Let computers communicate over a network
items.why: A network interface card lets a computer communicate over a network.

items.prompt: What is the SMS message about?
items.why: An SMS password is used to authenticate the user.

items.prompt: Which health problem might heavy online gaming cause?
items.why: Gaming more than 8 hours a day can disrupt sleep.

items.prompt: Which action protects a user from a hacker attack?
items.why: A firewall blocks unauthorised access from outside the network.

items.prompt: Which is a major characteristic of open source software?
options: Users can change the source code
items.why: Open source software lets users view, change and share the source code.

items.prompt: Which action is not appropriate without members' consent?
options: Sending personal information to other shops
items.why: Sharing members' personal information with other shops needs their consent.

items.prompt: Which application shows a dialogue blocking a program from private networks?
items.why: A firewall blocks the program from accessing private networks and asks for permission.
